name: hero
title: Hero
author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
description: Eyebrow, headline, subhead, actions and optional media. Media accepts a placeholder state and renders a correctly proportioned empty plate rather than requiring a live src. Variants: centered, split.
docs: `media.src` is optional on purpose. A section that hard-requires a URL cannot be placed in a wireframe, and the consumer then forks the layout locally to show an empty plate. The first entry in `actions` renders primary and the rest ghost; that is a rendering rule, not content.
